title: Code block style, annotation circles under a broad set block rule (Skylighting)

_quarto:

    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

A template or an extension can wrap code blocks in a broad `set block` rule.
The annotation circle must stay on its code line, so an annotated code block has the same height as the same code block without annotations.

```{=typst}
#show block.where(stroke: 0.5pt + luma(128)): it => {
  context [#metadata(measure(it, width: 400pt).height) <cbs-height>]
  it
}
#[
#set block(width: 100%)
```

```python
x = 1
y = 2
```

```python
x = 1 # <1>
y = 2
```

```{=typst}
]
```

1. First.

```{=typst}
#context {
  let heights = query(<cbs-height>).map(m => m.value)
  assert.eq(heights.len(), 2, message: "expected 2 code blocks")
  assert(calc.abs(heights.at(1) - heights.at(0)) < 0.5pt, message: "a broad set block rule moved the annotation circle off its code line")
}
```
